# Statista

> > Statista is a leading statistics portal providing data-driven infographics, market research, and statistical insights across health, economics, industry, and social topics.

Statista aggregates statistics from authoritative sources including Statistisches Bundesamt, Robert Koch-Institut, and Credit Suisse to create accessible visualizations and data reports. The platform covers diverse topics from COVID-19 epidemiology and global wealth distribution to petrochemical production capacity and travel trends.

## Key Topics

- COVID-19 statistics and epidemiology
- German demographic data (Deutschland)
- Global wealth distribution and inequality
- Petrochemical industry production (ethylene, urea, butadiene)
- Robert Koch-Institut health data
- Statistisches Bundesamt official statistics
- Age group analysis (Altersgruppen)
- Virus mutations (B.1.1.7)
- Long-COVID and Post-COVID effects
- Travel and tourism statistics
- Social issues (racism, inequality)
- Market research and industry analytics
- Infographic visualizations (Infografik)
- Global economic indicators
- China industrial statistics

## Health and Epidemiology Statistics

- [Infografik: Immer mehr Kinder infizieren sich mit COVID-19 | Statista](https://de.statista.com/infografik/21676/anteil-der-corona-infektionen-in-deutschland-nach-altersgruppen/): COVID-19 infections in Germany by age groups from Robert Koch-Institut
- [Infografik: Deutlich mehr Todesfälle im Sommer 2022 | Statista](https://de.statista.com/infografik/21523/anzahl-der-sterbefaelle-in-deutschland/): Germany mortality rates summer 2022 with COVID-19 and heat analysis

## Economic and Wealth Statistics

- [Infografik: Weltweiter Reichtum: Etwa ein Prozent der Menschen besitzen rund 40 Prozent des Vermögens | Statista](https://de.statista.com/infografik/1824/reichtumsverteilung-weltweit/): Global wealth distribution infographic based on Credit Suisse data

## Industry and Production Data

- [Ethylene production capacity globally 2023| Statista](https://www.statista.com/statistics/1067372/global-ethylene-production-capacity/): Global ethylene production capacity statistics for petrochemical industry

## Social Issues and Demographics

- [Infografik: Rassismus, ein Problem in allen Lebensbereichen | Statista](https://de.statista.com/infografik/24445/umfrage-zu-rassismus-in-verschiedenen-lebensbereichen/): YouGov survey on racism across different life areas in Germany

## Travel and Tourism Statistics

- [Infografik: Wohin reisen die Deutschen am liebsten? | Statista](https://de.statista.com/infografik/30492/anzahl-der-reisen-aus-deutschland-nach-ziellaendern/): German travel destinations statistics from Statistisches Bundesamt
